forbidden_dependencies: Direct launch imports of queue implementation
ClearML SDK imports outside its adapters
modules.effects: Random UUID creation and configuration mutation only; no storage, process or SDK effects

allowed_dependencies: existing application contracts and permitted outer composition dependencies
forbidden_dependencies: Direct launch imports of queue implementation

allowed_dependencies: existing application contracts and permitted outer composition dependencies
forbidden_dependencies: Direct launch imports of queue implementation

modules.effects: Existing composition and snapshot serialization; no new worker or storage effect
